//: The active character's own condition: its body as a tree of parts, each with how whole it is, its state and its wounds; the wounds one by one; and its reserves and attributes, which are content and are put into the slots `ui:condition.pools` and `ui:condition.attributes` by the mods that define them, as `ui:play.bars` is filled. All of it reads the character's own properties (`view.parts`, `view.wounds` and what they yield). Opened in play by the control `condition` (c).
title: Condition

tree.rows: if len(view.parts ?? []) == 0 or not is_null(view.parts[0].parent) then view.parts else [view.parts[0]]
tree.item: {it.name}  {round(it.condition * 100)}%  <dim>{it.state}{if len(it.wounds) == 0 then '' else if len(it.wounds) == 1 then ', 1 wound' else ', ' + str(len(it.wounds)) + ' wounds'}</>
tree.tip: Right opens a part, Left closes it.

list.item: {it.part.name}: {it.kind}, {it.state}{if it.stump then ', a stump' else ', ' + str(it.depth) + ' deep'}

tooltip.value: Tab moves between the body and the wounds. Esc: back.
